text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but I should weigh each stock’s prospects instead of using my average cost as the reason to sell.","Selling Stock D at a loss was painful; I should still reassess a losing position on its merits rather than hold it just to avoid realizing the loss.","My account has grown overall despite some declines, so I’ll review progress over time and make deliberate portfolio-wide decisions rather than react to monthly moves."]}
